recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有黏聚成團的小至中型圓形細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、有小核仁，細胞質淡藍且邊界不清，周圍有許多細小透明空泡（富含肝醣/脂質），與造血細胞不同，符合 Ewing 肉瘤等小圓藍細胞腫瘤侵犯骨髓。
features: Cohesive clusters of fairly uniform small to medium round cells
Round nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli; occasional binucleated cells
Scant to moderate pale-blue cytoplasm with indistinct borders forming a syncytial-appearing sheet
Numerous small clear vacuoles in and around the cells
Cells distinct from the scattered hematopoietic elements; background red cells and a few isolated tumor cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows cohesive clusters of fairly uniform small to medium round cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli, and scant to moderate pale-blue cytoplasm with indistinct borders. Numerous small clear cytoplasmic and background vacuoles are present, and isolated similar cells lie outside the clusters. The cells are distinct from normal hematopoietic elements. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by a small round cell tumor, compatible with Ewing sarcoma in the appropriate clinical setting; confirmation with CD99/NKX2.2 immunostains and EWSR1 rearrangement studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: Neuroblastoma shows Homer Wright rosettes with fibrillary neuropil, occurs in younger children, and is PHOX2B-positive and CD99-negative.
Rhabdomyosarcoma cells are more pleomorphic with vacuolated blue cytoplasm and express myogenin and desmin.
Lymphoblasts are discohesive with scant cytoplasm and express TdT and CD45, while Ewing sarcoma forms cohesive clusters and is CD45-negative.
